sentence: A US National Institutes of Health (NIH) news release dated 14 October 2026 describes an NIH-funded study in which scientists found that losartan, a common blood pressure medicine, increased brown fat activity and boosted metabolism in mice.
note: NIH news listing date Oct 14, 2026 (second retrieval).

sentence: The researchers first linked brown fat to the drug class called angiotensin receptor blockers by analysing data from more than 100,000 patients.
When they tested losartan directly on brown fat cells, it increased the cells' metabolic activity.
The findings come from patient data analysis and from experiments in mice and cells.
note: Verified job5: release itself says mice and cells.

sentence: The lead author suggests the approach could stimulate brown fat even in people with normal blood pressure, although the experiments so far were in mice and cells.
